entities.name: PMID:25443925
observations: Prospective institutional cohort: 131 prostate-cancer patients and 262 seminal vesicles; radical-prostatectomy pathology was the reference standard. Histoscanning SVI AUC was 0.54. At signal-volume cutoffs >0, >0.2, and >0.5 mL, sensitivity/specificity were 76.9%/10.8%, 61.5%/24.2%, and 46.2%/50.2%, respectively; investigators concluded SVI prediction was unreliable.

entities.name: PMID:33825986
observations: 2021 systematic review/meta-analysis reported low Histoscanning accuracy for extracapsular extension or seminal-vesicle invasion using post-radical-prostatectomy histology: pooled sensitivity 0.56 (95% CI 0.50–0.63), specificity 0.23 (95% CI 0.18–0.28), and AUC 0.40; 9 of 12 studies showed no benefit.
